needs: CFBD plays (play type, pace, run/pass, RPO flags) 2014+
CFB:cfb.offense_style.notes: ESPN cfb ledger is game-level only; play-level data not yet pulled. Style classes derived from season-to-date play mix, strictly pregame.

CFB:cfb.snap_weighted_availability_loss.limiting_source_or_reason: No free per-game CFB snap counts (PFF paid; CFBD usage is season-level); no official CFB injury report
CFB:cfb.snap_weighted_availability_loss.notes: Only partial proxies (CFBD season usage, beat-writer capture); weights cannot be built per game, and no historical availability vintage exists.

CFB:cfb.qb_sack_proneness.limiting_source_or_reason: PFF College pressure/time-to-throw paid; CFBD gives only sacks/dropbacks
CFB:cfb.qb_sack_proneness.notes: Sack rate alone is free but 'independent of line' needs pressure and line grades, which are paid-only. Raw sack rate would be REQUIRES_COLLECTION.

needs: nba_api leaguedashptstats/boxscoreplayertrackv3 touches, time of possession
NBA:nba.touches.notes: Not in repo archives (ESPN box lacks touches). Per-game tracking available 2013-14+; reachability from runner untested.

needs: BBRef position estimates / NBA synergy play types / tracking
NBA:nba.player_role_position.notes: ESPN archives have no positions or play types; must be pulled and encoded. Classification from season-to-date data is pregame-safe.

NBA:nba.game_pace_composition.notes: Composition rule from two teams' tempos can be fit on archived possessions and start times; play-type frequency is optional extra.

NBA:nba.deflection_rate.notes: ESPN archive has steals/minutes but not deflections. Per-game availability of hustle stats flagged unverified in catalog.

NBA:nba.contest_shooting_skill_transfer.limiting_source_or_reason: NBA Stats shooting splits, BBRef, NBA.com contest results
NBA:nba.contest_shooting_skill_transfer.notes: Rack-level past contest results are sparse (few shooters yearly) so transfer is modeled from C&S/FT%; if rack-level ball data is demanded it would be BLOCKED.

CBB:cbb.player_impact.notes: ESPN CBB ledger holds games only, no player rows. Barttorvik free player stats; dated snapshots may need own computation for point-in-time.

needs: team and opponent 3PA/3PM and 3P% by game
CBB:cbb.three_pt_luck.notes: True shot quality (defender distance) is not public; proxy from zones/assist share is free. Luck vs season-to-date 3P% is straightforward.

CBB:cbb.officials_crew.limiting_source_or_reason: No systematic public pregame CBB assignments (catalog NONE_FOUND); ESPN lists officials only post-game
CBB:cbb.officials_crew.notes: Past crews with foul counts are scrapeable from ESPN summaries, but pregame assignment is not reliably published, so pregame use fails.

CBB:cbb.player_three_volume.notes: Catch-and-shoot share proper is tracking data; assisted-3 share is a free proxy.

needs: ESPN CBB play-by-play with substitutions and scores
CBB:cbb.bench_unit_efficiency.notes: Games ledger only (31k games); PBP not pulled. Lineups derived from subs; garbage time defined by score margin and clock.

needs: shot zones by team and opponent
rebound events with location and rebounder position
CBB:cbb.miss_location_mix.limiting_source_or_reason: hoop-math (unverified), Barttorvik, ESPN PBP shot coords (partial)
CBB:cbb.miss_location_mix.notes: ESPN CBB coordinates are partial; rebound-by-miss-location linkage requires PBP sequence. Team-level zone rates are free.

CBB:cbb.crash_vs_get_back_scheme.notes: ORB%/DRB% easy; transition classification needs PBP-derived proxy (e.g., points within seconds of turnover/miss).

CBB:cbb.three_makes_compound_distributio.notes: Model is own computation; only player game logs must be pulled (ESPN CBB ledger lacks player rows).

needs: daily KenPom AdjEM table for all D1 teams
CBB:cbb.kenpom_adjem_gap_density.limiting_source_or_reason: KenPom ratings are subscription-paywalled; only Barttorvik proxy free
CBB:cbb.kenpom_adjem_gap_density.notes: Target is KenPom itself; Barttorvik is a different rating so gap density differs. Daily KenPom history is not free. Becomes REQUIRES_COLLECTION if a proxy is accepted.

CBB:cbb.kenpom_prior_drift.notes: Barttorvik T-Rank archives free as proxy, but exact KenPom path/prior is paid. Wayback partial only.

needs: NHL API play-by-play penalty events with period/time
NHL:nhl.period_penalty_intensity_balance.notes: Repo has shots/goalie/team states, no penalty events. Pregame crews are announced day-of; historical crews backfillable from summaries.

SOCCER:soc.gk.limiting_source_or_reason: PSxG is Opta/StatsBomb-only; FBref Opta data withdrawn, Understat has no PSxG
SOCCER:soc.gk.notes: Save% vs shots-on-target is free proxy but PSxG-GA proper needs shot placement data, unavailable free beyond StatsBomb open samples.

SOCCER:soc.motivation.notes: Table stakes computable from free results once pulled; rotation component needs prospective lineup capture.

SOCCER:soc.player_awards.notes: Leaders production is counting stats from free sources; nothing archived yet.

needs: PSxG or shots-on-target xG per keeper
SOCCER:soc.keeper_shot_stopping_regressi.limiting_source_or_reason: PSxG paid/unavailable (Opta); Understat lacks on-target xG
SOCCER:soc.keeper_shot_stopping_regressi.notes: Regression on save% vs shots on target is possible free but over/under-performance relative to shot quality needs PSxG.

SOCCER:soc.international_break_effect.notes: All free but scrape/encode required; Transfermarkt ToS caveat.

needs: shots with situation tags (corner, set piece, free kick) for/against
SOCCER:soc.set_piece_matchup.notes: Understat tags shot situation for top-5 leagues; defensive set-piece concession derived from opponents' shots.

SOCCER:soc.extra_time_shootout_model.notes: Shootout outcomes are small-sample but fully public; encoding needed.

SOCCER:soc.squad_depth_value.notes: Transfermarkt values are community estimates not betting prices; point-in-time values recoverable via snapshots only partially.

SOCCER:soc.penalty_taker_status.notes: Designated taker inferred from past takers; pregame confirmation absent for XI-dependent cases.

needs: shot-level xG with minute and goal timeline
SOCCER:soc.score_effects_adjusted_xg.notes: Score state derived from goal minutes; adjustment model is own computation.

needs: shot X/Y, xG, result, player per match
SOCCER:soc.opp_shot_profile_by_zone.notes: Understat covers big-5 + RPL only; other leagues lack free shot coordinates.

needs: goal/shot events with minute and score
SOCCER:soc.trailing_team_response_hazard.notes: Goal-minute data suffices for hazard; free and deep.

SOCCER:soc.club_multi_competition_depend.notes: Joint estimate is a modeling task with scarce events; data free but dependence estimation weak.

SOCCER:soc.lineup_surprise_vs_predicted.notes: Actual XI backfillable, but predicted-XI vintages must be captured prospectively (or reconstructed by model).

SOCCER:soc.season_minutes_survival_curve.notes: Injury history free via scrape; minutes from lineups.

needs: event sequences linking shot outcome to resulting corner
SOCCER:soc.corner_generation_by_shot_out.limiting_source_or_reason: Only match-level corners (football-data.co.uk) and shot results (Understat); sequences only in Opta/StatsBomb open samples
SOCCER:soc.corner_generation_by_shot_out.notes: Match-level regression of corners on blocked/saved counts is a free proxy, but per-attack linkage needs event data with partial free coverage.

SOCCER:soc.dnp_and_sub_entry_settlement.limiting_source_or_reason: Transfermarkt/ESPN lineups, own capture of confirmed XI
SOCCER:soc.dnp_and_sub_entry_settlement.notes: History of subs/DNPs free; confirmed lineups ~1h pregame must be captured prospectively.

needs: shot events with minute, player, score state
SOCCER:soc.player_shot_volume_state_resp.notes: Player-level shot minutes free; needs pull.

SOCCER:soc.pair_player_tournament_tally_.notes: Joint distribution is a simulation on free inputs; tally history small per player.

SOCCER:soc.skills_challenge_format_and_f.limiting_source_or_reason: No public drill-level skill data; past results tiny sample
SOCCER:soc.skills_challenge_format_and_f.notes: Format and field are announced, but entrant drill skill does not exist publicly; only passing/shooting accuracy proxies.

SOCCER:soc.concession_race_schedule.notes: Schedule and goal minutes are free public data.

needs: goal type per goal (direct FK, olimpico, GK goals)
SOCCER:soc.rare_goal_event_base_rates.limiting_source_or_reason: StatsBomb open data, Understat DirectFreekick, Wikipedia lists
SOCCER:soc.rare_goal_event_base_rates.notes: Olimpico and GK goals need curated lists; denominators from open data complete tournaments.

SOCCER:soc.lead_protection_knockout_conv.notes: Free; encoding of tournament matches needed.

SOCCER:soc.national_team_call_up_history.notes: Historical squads free; encoding per federation required.

needs: point-level rally length and return data for all players
TENNIS:ten.return_style_rally.limiting_source_or_reason: Only Match Charting Project (volunteer subset, skewed to top players) and paid Sportradar
TENNIS:ten.return_style_rally.notes: Sackmann match CSVs give serve/return aggregates but no rally length; charted sample is partial.

needs: live scoreboard server and game score
TENNIS:ten.server_game_state.limiting_source_or_reason: ESPN tennis scoreboard / ATP-WTA live scores
TENNIS:ten.server_game_state.notes: Live-only; must be captured prospectively. Whether ESPN exposes the server flag was not verified.

needs: point-level server, side, winner for broad player pool
TENNIS:ten.court_side_point_asymmetry.notes: Charted data cover limited players/matches; slam point-by-point is also a subset.

needs: serve direction and outcome per point
TENNIS:ten.serve_direction_mix_vs_return.notes: Direction coded only in Match Charting Project subset.

TENNIS:ten.within_match_serve_decay.limiting_source_or_reason: Sackmann slam point-by-point (slams only) and MCP
TENNIS:ten.within_match_serve_decay.notes: Tour-level point data exist only for slams/charted matches, a partial sample; match minutes are in repo CSVs.
